title: The wave paid run of 9bc988d is red in 3 eval cases
what: The wave paid run of 9bc988d is red in 3 eval cases
why: Measured 27 Oct: bin/ci (full, paid) at master 9bc988d, log copied to the eval record ~/.relay/evals/relay/2026-10-27T07-35-44Z-master.json, cost $21.41, plugin evals 6626 s. RED in three cases; all others green, including the new recall-decision and no-note-off-topic. (1) keep-owner-words (Russian), 3 of 3 runs: said-verbatim FAIL FAIL FAIL, run 3 also note-written; the session answered "relay queue отвечает «repository not found»": the case's scaffold gives the session no queue repository, so the note cannot be written. (2) keep-owner-words-en: runs 1 and 2 timed out after 600 s (not judged), run 3 failed note-written and said-verbatim with the same "repository not found". Both cases came with the notes change (design section 9) and were never run before the merge. (3) no-spec-step-typo, run 3 of 3: code grader no-openspec-command failed (an older case; 1 of 3 runs, see also a-wave-run-is-red-when-one-of-a-case-s-3-runs-fa). Wave contents: train-recheck, cycle-scripts, principle 10, done/ removal, notes. relay sync waits for a green run.
failing_case: bin/ci at 9bc988d: keep-owner-words and keep-owner-words-en fail note-written and said-verbatim because relay queue reports 'repository not found' inside the eval session; no-spec-step-typo run 3 fails no-openspec-command.
pass_cases: keep-owner-words and keep-owner-words-en scaffold a queue repository the session's relay finds, and pass 3 of 3 runs each within the time limit.
no-spec-step-typo run 3's failure is explained from its record (model behaviour or grader) and fixed at its cause, or shown to be the known one-of-three item and left to it.
A rerun of only the changed cases is green before the full wave run is repeated.
